events.name: New Year's Eve - Countdown Party
events.description: Get ready to ring in the New Year at our Red Hot New Year’s Eve Celebration! This all-ages party features live music, a festive champagne toast at midnight*, and an exciting countdown to 2027 complete with sparkling sparklers to light up the moment. Bring your family and friends for an unforgettable evening filled with music, celebration, and cosmic fun as we blast off into the New Year together! Please note: Guests under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Pick up your wristbands at the Concierge Desk on New Year’s Eve.

events.name: Bimini Homecoming
events.description: Bimini’s biggest domestic event of the year. This native festival featuring Bahamina culture: seafood dishes, tropical drinks, Bahamian live entertainment, beach parties, and 4 days of fun, fun, fun. This event will begin just before Good Friday and will end on Easter Sunday with a big bash. Homecoming Grounds Alice Town & Radio Beach • Sinclair Forbes President, Bimini 2026 Homecoming Committee (242) 473-4955

events.name: People to People Tea Party (In Collaboration with the Gardening Club)
events.description: People to People pairs visitors with local ambassadors to get to know each other through shared interests, food, drink, music and dance. Grounds of the George Weech Administrative Complex Grace Giste Bimini Tourist office (242) 347-7000

events.name: Tom Tucker Annual Fishing Tournament
events.description: A long-running Bahamas sport fishing event organized mainly by the Construction Association of South Florida (CASF). In 2026 it returns to Bimini Big Game Club Resort & Marina. Named after Tom Tucker, a well-known South Florida marine construction and boating figure. Part fishing competition, part networking getaway for boating, marina, marine construction, and yachting industry people from Florida and the Bahamas. Typical format: Thursday: Captain’s Party / Welcome Reception. Friday: Main fishing day. Friday evening: Weigh-in and awards. Saturday: Social raft-up, usually around Honeymoon Harb

events.name: Black Boaters of SOFLO Bimini Bash
events.description: Get ready for the Battle of The Boats • Day 1 Depart Miami, Thursday May 28 7:00 am, ETA Bimini 10:00 am. Clear customs • Rooftop pool party 4-7pm. Friday May 29, explore Bimini by boat: SS Samona shipwreck, Eastwell Beach, Honeymoon Harbour Stingray feeding. 7:30pm beach party at Conch Fu Shack, Radio Beach • Day 3 Saturday May 31. 10:00 am Seafood Brunch at private waterfront home. 7:00 pm Dock Party and Yacht Feud Game Show Contest, Captains and Crew battle for top crew bragging rights, and Krew Karaoke battle. events.name: Bimini Boating Fling
events.description: Sponsored by The Bahamas Ministry of Tourism Investments & Aviation, join a flotilla of 20 to 30 boats lead by an experienced captain to cross the Gulf Stream and arrive safely. Dock at Resorts World or Fisherman's Village. Time on island is unstructured to give freedom to fish, dive, and explore or laze in the sun as you wish. Make new friends and expect camaraderie. Join for $125. — Resorts World Bimini Ahmad Williams (954) 236-9292 E: [email protected] . https://www.bahamas.com/boating-fling

events.name: Bimini Junkanoo Festival
events.description: Come and experience our unique Bahamian parade and join in! Hear us make music with horns, goat skin drums, cowbells and other percussive instruments as we “rush” and dance in colourful, fringed costumes. Held at the Craft Center, Alice Town. From noon until late at 11 pm. The parade starts at 9 pm. Come celebrate our most authentic cultural expression with us. Bimini Tourist Office (242) 347-7000.

events.name: Crossing For the Cure (Pipers Angels)
events.description: The Crossing for a Cure is a long-distance endurance paddle challenge that takes paddlers 50 miles across the Gulfstream from Bimini, Bahamas, to the Florida mainland. The event was inspired because of the incredible health benefits the ocean has on those living with cystic fibrosis. Big Game/Bimini Cove Bimini Tourist Office (242) 347-7000
